recent_runs: Week of Sep 14 2026: three continuous runs — 3.9 km, 4.0 km, 5.0 km at ~9:10–9:45/km on the treadmill. Regularly active: Peloton rides and Peloton strength/toning classes, weekly yoga.
training_notes: New parent (baby 3 months) — schedule is unpredictable. Sessions carry suggested days but ANY session in the current Monday–Sunday week may be done on ANY day, in any order; the app moves a session to the day it was done. Weeks close Sunday night; nothing carries over and nothing is pulled forward. Three runs per week (two shorter, one long run) plus ONE Peloton Strength class written exactly as 'Peloton Strength' (replaces the Peloton rides of the previous plan). If the week only fits three sessions the runs come first. Monday yoga stays a rest day from running. Goal: RUN the entire half marathon continuously, no time goal. Continuous running from day one with a rough pace guide; no run/walk intervals. No gym prescriptions — her strength work is the Peloton strength class.
